basics.name: Talal Ahmed
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Computer Science graduate and software engineer interested in building dependable web applications, backend services, automation, and small tools that solve practical problems. Comfortable moving from an idea to an implementation, working across systems, and using a security-minded approach throughout development.

highlights: Lead a team to organize workshops, competitions, and collaborative projects for students across all semesters
Mentored junior members and coordinated with faculty to align events with academic and career development goals

projects.name: AI-Driven SRS Generator (FYP)
highlights: Built a full-stack AI-powered platform that generates IEEE 830-compliant SRS documents.
Developed a multi-agent workflow with PostgreSQL-backed state management.
Integrated RAG, document export, and human-in-the-loop requirement elicitation.

projects.name: ML for Malware Detection
highlights: Built a Python ML project for polymorphic malware detection.
Used machine learning techniques for security-focused binary classification.
Applied Python, data analysis, and predictive modeling to cybersecurity.

projects.name: Timetable Parser
highlights: Developed a Python-based PDF parsing pipeline to extract timetable data from unstructured university documents.
Transformed semi-structured PDF content into normalized JSON output for downstream automation and integration.
Implemented document processing logic to handle data extraction, parsing, and structured serialization in Python.

projects.name: Department Website
highlights: Developed the official department website with Astro.
Designed reusable components and optimized performance for fast page loads.
